title: esm2-flu-s：ESM2 在 TAPE 荧光蛋白（FLU-S）上的零样本打分 vs 轻量微调可复现基准
description:
Reproducible mini-benchmark of ESM2 zero-shot scoring versus lightweight fine-tuning heads on the TAPE fluorescent-protein (FLU-S) task: four frozen encoders x two zero-shot calibres x regression heads, bootstrap 95% CIs on all Spearman numbers, Fisher-z / Delta-rho stratified tests with Bonferroni correction, and negative results published as-is.

esm2-flu-s：把「复现单模型」做成四编码器 x 两种零样本口径 x 回归头的公开基准；统一头协议下全部 Spearman 带 bootstrap 95% CI，分层差经双口径检验（Bonferroni 校正），负结果如实公开。
